The '''Kossa sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Ankori-7]], [[Basarais]] and [[Hrasskis]].
